reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "⚠️ Metrics: Disable by default", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Controllers that do not pass --enable-metrics explicitly now run with metrics disabled by default.
consequence.remediation: If you rely on controller metrics, set --enable-metrics=true explicitly before upgrading.

proposed.statement: In ingress-nginx 1.12.0 the controller CLI argument --enable-metrics is now disabled by default, so metrics are off unless the flag is set explicitly.
